instruction: Look at freecad_task-17_input.step in FreeCAD. Convert the rectangular block into a V-block clamp. Keep the 120 x 50 x 40 mm outside envelope. Cut a full-length 90-degree V groove along X, centered on Y=25 mm and open at the top; the groove vertex is at Y=25 mm, Z=18 mm, and its top edges are at Y=3 mm and Y=47 mm on the Z=40 mm top face. Cut three vertical clamp screw holes of diameter 8 mm at X=25,60,95 mm on Y=25 mm, with top counterbores of diameter 18 mm and depth 6 mm. Cut two long horizontal relief holes of diameter 10 mm along X, centered at Y=8 and Y=42 mm, Z=20 mm. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-17_output.step. Use interactive GUI steps only and do not use external scripts.
